hooks.name: Enforce Project Conventions

action.prompt: Before writing this file, verify: 1) Tests import { test, expect } from src/fixtures/pageFixtures.js, 2) No raw selectors in test files, 3) Page objects extend BasePage, 4) No hard-coded credentials, 5) No test.only added.

hooks.description: Reminds the agent to follow project conventions before writing test or page files
